name: r360_sql
description: Run one READ-ONLY SQL query on the RuPay 360 semantic layer and get rows back. Use for any number you need, including new metrics you invent. Personal-data columns and raw-table dumps are refused; aggregate inside the query. Always state the purpose.

name: r360_describe_tables
description: List the tables and columns you may query.

name: r360_run_insights
description: Run the Watcher on the latest (or given) week, investigate every flag against the catalogs and data, and save new findings to the ledger.

name: r360_get_finding
description: Get one finding's full evidence bundle (flag, candidate causes, tests with SQL, cautions).

name: r360_offers_active
description: Offers live in a date window, optionally for one merchant, category or issuer. Each offer carries its source.

name: r360_catalog_search
description: Keyword search across CVP cards, offers and proposition events.

name: r360_card
description: Full CVP record for one card_id (e.g. YES_SELECT, IDFC_FIRST_WEALTH).

name: r360_proposition_events
description: Dated CVP / MITC changes in a window, optionally for one issuer.

name: r360_deal_engine
description: Run the verified Deal Model V1.1 engine. Returns net / gross / incentive BPS, totals and per-year results. Never estimate deal economics yourself.

name: r360_source_check
description: Check whether a bank page or PDF text changed since the last approved extraction (hash compare). Extract only if changed.

name: r360_propose_catalog_change
description: Propose a change to a CVP, MITC, offers or events catalog file. Goes to the Curator Queue; never edits the catalog directly. Sources are mandatory.

name: r360_propose_metric
description: Propose a new metric you found useful: name, plain definition, the SQL. The SQL is test-run first. Goes to the Curator Queue for the metric dictionary.

name: r360_record_verdict
description: Record an analyst's verdict on a finding (CORRECT, WRONG, PARTLY) with the true cause if known. Only when the analyst says so.

name: r360_scorecard
description: Precision of past findings by cause type and confidence, from analyst verdicts.

name: r360_validate_catalog
description: Validate all catalog files against their schemas.
